# agent caffeine

> agent caffeine is a macOS menu bar app that keeps a Mac awake while AI coding agents work, also with the lid closed, and lets it sleep when they are idle. It costs $9 once and runs on macOS 13 or later (Apple silicon and Intel).

- Detects more than 40 coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, opencode, Gemini CLI, Cursor and others) by process name, plus Claude Code session files.
- Three modes: always, while an agent is open, or while an agent is working (the default).
- A closed lid on power works out of the box. On battery it needs a one-time admin prompt that installs a sudoers entry, and it turns on `pmset disablesleep` only while it holds the Mac awake.
- No network calls and no telemetry.
